rationale: The signal establishes only that {a,b} does not reproduce F. It does not establish that {a,c} reproduces F, that every smaller subset fails to reproduce F, or that no other equally small subset reproduces F. Deterministic replay and a direct oracle do not supply those missing results.

signal_basis.exact_text: Replays are deterministic under the fixed workload and environment.
Under the frozen oracle that directly measures F, subset {a,b} does not reproduce F on the recorded replay.
